title: The Semantic Inquiry Graph
what_this_is: The vocabulary of semantic compilation: how a rich visual question and an abundant provisional
reading become source-anchored atoms, atomic typed claims, the relations between them, and the
observables that would have to be produced for any of them to gain support.
It is DATA rather than code because the enums are the load-bearing part. A claim kind or a capability
class invented at a call site is indistinguishable from one somebody decided, and the compiler is a
model — the closed sets are exactly what it is not allowed to extend on its own.
what_v2_adds: v1 asked ONE model call to turn prose into claims, edges, observables, decisions and remainder at
once. HARNESS-002R's rehearsal showed the failure that produces: an abundant reading became a
truncated prefix, then a barren graph, and the graph was correct to say so and useless to a person.
v2 does not raise the token limit. It interposes a LEDGER between the prose and the graph.
Every prompt clause and every accepted reading block becomes a SourceUnit. A dissector emits
SemanticAtoms anchored to those units. Every source unit then receives exactly ONE coverage
disposition, so 'what happened to that paragraph' is answerable rather than inferable.
Claims are built over accepted atoms, not over prose. Observables are derived from claims, not from
the images. Each pass is a separate role with its own prompt, budget and receipt, so an
underperformance is attributable to a mind rather than to 'the compiler'.
v1 remains READABLE. Stored sessions and frozen fixtures validate unchanged; they simply carry no
source units, no atoms and no coverage, which is what they in fact never had.
not_this: Not the Perceptual Action Grammar (what act may be PROPOSED to a curator).
Not the Director's actuator vocabulary (what globally scoped operation has an EXECUTOR).
Not the agent organ vocabulary (what a body can perceive FROM ITS LOCUS).
A capability CLASS is a fourth thing again: what KIND of instrument a claim would need. It names no
implementation on purpose, so that the broker — not the compiler — chooses one, and so that a class
with no instrument today is a visible gap rather than an unfilled tool name.

what: One addressable piece of source prose. Everything the dissector is allowed to read is a source
unit, and everything that is a source unit must be accounted for afterwards.
source_units.prompt_clause: a clause of the person's own prompt, split deterministically, with its exact span
source_units.reading_block: one accepted SceneReading block, with its block id, text and image refs
spans_are_computed: A prompt clause carries the character span it occupies in the verbatim prompt, computed by the
splitter from the prompt itself. No model is ever asked for an offset: an invented offset renders
in a UI as a highlight over words the person did not write. A quote that does not resolve keeps
its pointer with `span: null` and is reported.

atom_kinds.entity: a thing the source says is present
atom_kinds.visual_quality: a property of a thing as it appears — its finish, its edge, its weight, its apparent material
atom_kinds.relation: two things and how one stands to the other
atom_kinds.comparison: a statement holding ACROSS sources or images; needs more than one by construction
atom_kinds.interpretation: a reading ABOUT what is there; not a weak observation, a different kind of unit
atom_kinds.historical_or_sourced: a unit whose warrant lies outside the picture
atom_kinds.causal_hypothesis: an X because Y, or an X produces the effect Y
atom_kinds.generative_proposal: a proposal for something that does not exist yet
atom_kinds.unknown: the dissector could not type it. LEGAL and VISIBLE, for the same reason `unknown` is a claim kind.

coverage_dispositions.represented_by: one or more atoms carry this unit's content; refs are atom ids
coverage_dispositions.duplicate_of: another source unit says the same thing; refs is that source unit id
coverage_dispositions.semantic_remainder: real content that no atom captures, kept as remainder with a reason
coverage_dispositions.refused: the unit was not dissolved, with a reason. Not the same as remainder: remainder is content nothing measures, refused is content nothing processed.

pass_outcomes.completed: references resolve and every source unit has exactly one disposition
pass_outcomes.thin: coverage exists, but the relations or operationalization the produced atom kinds imply are absent. Reported, never padded.
pass_outcomes.truncated: a pass reported a length stop. Whatever it produced is a PREFIX.
pass_outcomes.coverage_failed: at least one source unit has no disposition, or has more than one
pass_outcomes.empty: the pass ran and produced nothing
pass_outcomes.unavailable: the pass could not run; nothing was attempted

claim_kinds.entity: A thing the reading says is present. The only kind a segmenter can even be asked about.
claim_kinds.attribute: A property OF something — its scale, its density, its finish.
claim_kinds.spatial_relation: Two things and where they stand to each other.
claim_kinds.topology: Connectedness, enclosure, containment, holes — relations that survive deformation.
claim_kinds.pattern_or_sequence: A repetition or an ordering; the recurrence is the claim, not any one member.
claim_kinds.field: A continuous quantity spread over the picture rather than located in one thing.
claim_kinds.hierarchy: A part/whole or dominance ordering across several things.
claim_kinds.comparison: A statement that holds ACROSS images. Needs more than one image by construction.
claim_kinds.historical_or_sourced: A claim whose warrant is outside the picture. Never settled by looking.
claim_kinds.causal_hypothesis: A because. The consequences may be observable; the link itself is not.
claim_kinds.interpretation: A reading ABOUT the picture. Not a weak measurement — a different kind of claim.
claim_kinds.generative_rule: A rule for making something that does not exist. Imagined by construction.
claim_kinds.unknown: The compiler could not type it. LEGAL and VISIBLE — see the law of the same name.

why: The dissector types what a SOURCE UNIT says; the relation architect types what a CLAIM asserts.
They are different vocabularies on purpose — `visual_quality` is a thing a person can say about
an appearance, and `attribute` is a thing a graph can hold a warrant for — and this table is the
only place they meet. It is a DEFAULT the architect may override with a reason, never a rewrite

extent.asks_for: where a named thing is, as an extent on the image

geometry.asks_for: a computed relation between extents — containment, adjacency, centrality, alignment

topology.asks_for: connectedness, enclosure, holes; relations that survive deformation

pattern.asks_for: recurrence, spacing, rhythm, ordering across the frame

scalar_field.asks_for: a continuous per-pixel quantity — density, pressure, luminance

vector_field.asks_for: a continuous per-pixel direction — flow, orientation, surface normal

semantic_reading.asks_for: a sentence about the picture, produced by a thinker
semantic_reading.never_settles: a measurable demand. A reading is not evidence in the picture.

external_source.asks_for: a citation from outside the picture
external_source.never_settles: a measurable demand. Nothing measured in the frame can stand in for a source.

ground_forms.frame: the whole image, as the thing being spoken about
ground_forms.field: a continuous quantity over an image
ground_forms.path: an ordered traversal — a direction, a sequence, a trajectory
ground_forms.relation: a named link between two grounds

historical_or_sourced.why: its warrant lies outside the picture. `epistemics.py` walls `sourced` for this reason; the same wall is applied one level up, on the claim, before any instrument is chosen.

interpretation.why: an interpretation does not become measurable because measurements contribute to it. That promotion is the single failure HARNESS-001A's semantic remainder exists to prevent.

causal_hypothesis.why: the CONSEQUENCES of a because may be observable and should be emitted as observables on separate claims. The link itself is not something an instrument returns.

generative_rule.why: a rule for making what does not exist has nothing to measure and nothing to cite. HARNESS-001B declined to give `imagined` an EpistemicStatus for exactly this reason.

comparison.why: a comparison across images is not available from one image. Typed from one, it would be a corpus tendency asserted from a single observation.

id_rule: Every id is sha256 over the inquiry id, the object's kind, and the object's STABLE CONTENT,
truncated to 12 hex characters and prefixed. Nothing is minted from a clock or a counter.
Replaying a frozen model output must produce the same graph byte for byte, and an id derived
from list position would silently renumber the moment a model reordered its own output.
A SOURCE UNIT's identity is its normalized source identity plus its normalized text — never its
position in the ledger, because a reading block the theorist emits in a different order is the
forbidden_geometry_why: A scene theorist reads pixels and is still a thinker: it may say a thing is there and may not say
WHERE, in numbers. The moment a reading can carry a box, its output is a measurement nobody measured
and every downstream consumer that checks provenance will find a legitimate-looking one.

laws.message: a scene reading, an atom or a compiled claim may not carry a geometry, region, mark or confidence key
laws.why: the strongest thing a thinker may produce is `interpretive`. Geometry is what an organ produces.

laws.message: a claim may not start as `visible` or `measured`
laws.why: nothing has run. A compiler that could mint a measured claim would make the whole evidence layer decorative.

laws.message: every source unit is represented, duplicate, remainder or refused — exactly one of the four
laws.why: the whole point of the ledger. Zero dispositions means a paragraph vanished and nothing says so; two means the graph tells two stories about the same words and a reader cannot tell which is the record.

laws.message: an atom names at least one source unit that is in the ledger, and quotes it
laws.why: an unanchored atom is prose the dissector wrote. It reads exactly like one it found.

laws.message: an atom whose source unit is a prompt clause keeps `author: user`
laws.why: the person's hypothesis rewritten as a model observation is the most valuable thing in the ledger, laundered. It is also the one error a reader cannot detect downstream, because a model observation is exactly what the rest of the graph is made of.

laws.message: the relation architect receives atoms and their source pointers; it receives no image, no post and no unanchored reading prose
laws.why: a pass that can see would add visual content with no source unit behind it, and the coverage ledger would still report complete.

laws.message: a claim resolves to atoms, or declares `compiler_inference` and names parents that resolve
laws.why: an unanchored claim is one nobody said and nothing produced. It reads exactly like the others.

laws.message: a `compiler_inference` claim names the claims or atoms it was inferred from
laws.why: an inference with no parents is an assertion wearing an inference's clothes.

laws.message: a term recorded as semantic remainder may not also carry a `measurable` demand
laws.why: HARNESS-001A's rule, applied to the graph. A remainder is what measurement does not reach.

laws.message: an observable serving an interpretation states what remains interpretive even if it succeeds
laws.why: the operationalizer's version of the remainder rule. A contributing measurement that silently closed the interpretation would be the promotion the whole layer exists to prevent.

laws.message: an observable serving a `historical_or_sourced` claim must request `external_source`
laws.why: a historical generalization routed to an image capability becomes an image measurement of a claim the image cannot settle.

laws.message: a `comparison` claim may not be scoped to `one_image`
laws.why: one observation typed as a corpus tendency is the cheapest way to manufacture a finding.

laws.message: `unknown` is an atom kind and a claim kind, and an unoperationalizable claim is retained
laws.why: dropping what could not be typed makes the graph look more complete than the reading was.

laws.message: an atom kind, claim kind, capability class, ground form, edge kind or disposition outside the closed sets is refused BY NAME
laws.why: how often a model invents a vocabulary is the observable that says whether to trust it. Silently dropped, it is unobservable.

laws.message: a pass reports `completed` only when its references resolve and its coverage is whole; parsed JSON alone reports `thin`, `truncated` or `coverage_failed`
laws.why: the HARNESS-002R failure exactly. A truncated prefix that happens to close its JSON is indistinguishable from an honest short answer unless something else is checked.

laws.message: at most one targeted repair call per compilation, carrying only the uncovered units and the audit errors, and both attempts are recorded
laws.why: a retry loop hides a bad prompt behind a good average, and a repair that resends the whole reading is a second attempt at the failed call rather than a repair.

laws.message: an unavailable or unparseable model produces an empty graph carrying a refusal, never a canned result
laws.why: a plausible default is indistinguishable from a real reading and would be believed.

laws.message: the graph carries the user's prompt byte for byte, and every prompt clause quotes it exactly
laws.why: every refusal downstream is only checkable against what was actually asked.

no_topic_branch: No production module reading this contract may name a topic. There is no fold branch, no sculpture
branch, no architecture branch, and no botany branch. Subjects, predicates, targets and descriptions
are open strings; the closed sets above are shapes, not subjects.
`test_semantic_compilation_generality.py` scans the production sources for the fixtures' topic nouns
and fails by name if one appears.
